extra.text: A 30% chance to dodge any hit.
You cannot wear anything on your head or chest, elytra included.
Climb walls. Melee hits wrap the target in cobweb.
You heal for a fifth of every melee hit you deal.
Nothing else heals you over time: food fills you but does not mend you, and Regeneration does nothing.
You take 6% less damage at level 5, and another 6% each time your level doubles, up to 30% at level 80.
Each hit you take burns 10 experience points, and levels spent on enchanting stop protecting you.
Nothing knocks you back, and your armor counts for half again as much.
Nine extra inventory slots, kept on death. Natural armor. Break stone bare-handed.
Under a roof you mine twice as fast and see in the dark.
Under open sky in daylight you are 25% slower and deal 30% less melee damage.
Under a roof: mine twice as fast
Under a roof: see in the dark
In daylight under open sky: slow and weak
Eat while full; eating while full gives a minute of Absorption
Your empty hand hits as hard as a diamond sword, at a fist's speed.
Swords, axes and tridents deal no damage in your hands.
Fall slowly. Walk faster. Lay an egg each morning.
No meat. Can only sleep high up.
Breathe, see and mine freely underwater. Swim fast.
No fall damage. Higher sprint jumps. Creepers keep away. See in the dark.
One fewer heart. Cannot mine stone that has stone beside it.
Each 1.5 shanks you are below 9 gives +8% melee damage and +4% movement speed, up to +40% and +20% at 1.5 shanks.
Staying that hungry means no natural regeneration, and eating switches the bonus off.
At 7.5 shanks or fewer: +8% melee damage, +4% speed
At 6 shanks or fewer: +8% melee damage, +4% speed
At 4.5 shanks or fewer: +8% melee damage, +4% speed
At 3 shanks or fewer: +8% melee damage, +4% speed
At 1.5 shanks or fewer: +8% melee damage, +4% speed
Built-in wings. Launch into the air. Hit harder while flying.
Light armor only. Weak under low ceilings. Crashing hurts more.
Your projectiles deal +25% from 16 blocks, and another 25% every 8 blocks after, up to double at 40.
Burns in daylight. Always hungry. Three fewer hearts.
Your tamed animals deal triple damage and take a third.
Throw ender pearls at will. Longer reach.
Immune to fire, poison and hunger effects. Hit harder while burning.
Your projectiles deal more the closer the target: +10% within 12 blocks, up to +50% within 3.
Your empty hand mines like a diamond pickaxe, axe and shovel at once.
Tools break nothing in your hands.
Empty hand mines at diamond speed
